reason: The immediate goal is to put the station on reserve, so I’ll use the charged reserve at the service panel.
expectation: I expect essential systems to switch to reserve power, though the industrial plant may need a separate shutdown.

alternatives.reason: Stopping the industrial load also fits the storm warning, but the reserve is the current goal.

effect: Essential systems are on reserve and production has stopped, but the exterior circuits still need securing.
reaction: The distinction between stopping production and keeping shutdown controls powered makes sense.
reason: I’ll secure the exterior water line at the panel to protect it during the power interruption.
expectation: I expect the panel to put the well line into a safer state, perhaps by isolating or draining it; I’m unsure exactly how.

alternatives.reason: The return plant also needs to be made safe, but I’ll address the exposed water line first.

effect: The exterior hose is drained before its heating is switched off; the return plant remains to be secured.
reaction: The order of draining before cutting heat is reassuring and physically sensible.
reason: The return plant is the only remaining gameplay action and needs to be made safe during the storm.
expectation: I expect the panel to finish shutting down and secure the plant's exterior equipment, though the details are unclear.

effect: The plant is safely isolated, though some stored propellant will boil off and need replacing after the storm.
reaction: The separate vents and acknowledged losses make the shutdown feel grounded rather than cost-free.

mostWorthwhile.text: Draining the exterior water line before switching off its trace heating was the most worthwhile moment: the sequence made its protective purpose clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Selecting the reserve was straightforward, though the explanation of the shutdown controls added useful detail.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the cold tanks would retain some liquid while venting boil-off, with the plant replacing the losses later.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each addressed a specific part of the storm response.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the station recovers and whether the discovery reaches Earth; the practical shutdown details made the situation engaging.
